description: In every nonempty actual structure, if both parents of an admissible generalized inference are true under every assignment, its exact chosen resolvent is true at every supplied assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.inference_sound.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type z}
  [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] {C D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L ℕ}
  (d : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.InferenceData C D)
  (hC : ∀ (v : ℕ → M), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseRealize C v)
  (hD : ∀ (v : ℕ → M), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseRealize D v) (v : ℕ → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseRealize
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.resolvent d) v
